paragraphs.source_zh: “静候兄长发落，甘做俎上之肉？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Indeed.”

units.source_zh: “正是。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “正是。”

paragraphs.source_en: “But what if my brother passes no judgment?”

units.source_en: “But what if my brother passes no judgment?”
units.source_zh: “但，若兄长并无发落呢？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “但，若兄长并无发落呢？”

paragraphs.source_en: “I believe the Shogun will first order you and your wife to separate.”

units.source_en: “I believe the Shogun will first order you and your wife to separate.”
units.source_zh: “在下以为，将军首先会令大人和夫人分开。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “在下以为，将军首先会令大人和夫人分开。”

paragraphs.source_en: “And I should meekly obey that order as well?”

units.source_en: “And I should meekly obey that order as well?”
units.source_zh: “我也要老老实实遵他命令吗？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “我也要老老实实遵他命令吗？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Indeed.”

units.source_en: “Indeed.”
units.source_zh: “正是。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “正是。”

paragraphs.source_en: “But my wife is not me. What if she tries to take her own life?”

units.source_en: “But my wife is not me. What if she tries to take her own life?”

units.source_zh: “但夫人非我，若她要寻短见，又当如何？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “但夫人非我，若她要寻短见，又当如何？”

paragraphs.source_en: “She will not take her own life.”

units.source_en: “She will not take her own life.”
units.source_zh: “她不会寻短见。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “她不会寻短见。”

paragraphs.source_en: “How do you know she will not?”

units.source_en: “How do you know she will not?”
units.source_zh: “你怎知道她不会？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你怎知道她不会？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Her Ladyship is a devout Christian, and the Christian faith forbids its believers to take their own lives.”

units.source_en: “Her Ladyship is a devout Christian, and the Christian faith forbids its believers to take their own lives.”

units.source_zh: “夫人乃是虔诚的洋教徒，洋教的教义不许信徒自杀。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “夫人乃是虔诚的洋教徒，洋教的教义不许信徒自杀。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Ah. A believer in God cannot take her own life. Yes, she will not do it.” Tadateru’s thoughts seemed to have turned to Irohahime in Edo.

units.source_en: “Ah.
A believer in God cannot take her own life. Yes, she will not do it.”
units.source_zh: 天主信徒不能自杀，是，她不会自杀。”

units.source_en: Tadateru’s thoughts seemed to have turned to Irohahime in Edo.
units.source_zh: 忠辉似已把思绪转到了江户的五郎八姬身上。

paragraphs.source_zh: “哦。天主信徒不能自杀，是，她不会自杀。”忠辉似已把思绪转到了江户的五郎八姬身上。

paragraphs.source_en: Katsutaka breathed a sigh of relief. The crisis seemed to have passed; perhaps Tadateru would now return quietly to Edo. If Tadateru truly left Sunpu peaceably, a great weight would be lifted from Katsutaka’s shoulders. Afterward, the Shogun and his close retainers would give due thought to everything else. Ah, but what a pity for Lord Kazusa-no-suke!

units.source_en: Katsutaka breathed a sigh of relief. The crisis seemed to have passed; perhaps Tadateru would now return quietly to Edo.

units.source_en: If Tadateru truly left Sunpu peaceably, a great weight would be lifted from Katsutaka’s shoulders.
units.source_zh: 若忠辉真能安分离开骏府，胜隆也就卸下了肩上一大重担。

units.source_en: Afterward, the Shogun and his close retainers would give due thought to everything else.
units.source_zh: 这之后诸事，将军和他的亲信自会好生考虑。

units.source_en: Ah, but what a pity for Lord Kazusa-no-suke!
units.source_zh: 唉，只可惜上总介大人了！

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜隆松了口气，危机似已过去，忠辉亦会不声不响回江户吧？若忠辉真能安分离开骏府，胜隆也就卸下了肩上一大重担。这之后诸事，将军和他的亲信自会好生考虑。唉，只可惜上总介大人了！

paragraphs.source_en: Tadateru filled his cup once more and sank into thought; he was now calmly considering what he ought to do next.

units.source_en: Tadateru filled his cup once more and sank into thought; he was now calmly considering what he ought to do next.
units.source_zh: 忠辉再次往酒杯里斟满了酒，陷入沉思，他已在冷静思量下一步该怎样了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 忠辉再次往酒杯里斟满了酒，陷入沉思，他已在冷静思量下一步该怎样了。

paragraphs.source_en: “Under these circumstances,” Katsutaka said again, “you must remain calm, my lord, and on no account lose your temper.”

units.source_en: “Under these circumstances,” Katsutaka said again, “you must remain calm, my lord, and on no account lose your temper.”
units.source_zh: “此情此景下，”胜隆再次说道，“请大人务必保持冷静，切忌暴躁。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “此情此景下，”胜隆再次说道，“请大人务必保持冷静，切忌暴躁。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Mm.”

units.source_en: “Mm.”

paragraphs.source_en: “This is a quagmire laid by fate. The more you struggle and rage, the deeper you will sink.”

units.source_en: “This is a quagmire laid by fate. The more you struggle and rage, the deeper you will sink.”
units.source_zh: “此乃命运泥潭，大人愈是挣扎，愈是着恼，便会陷得愈深。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “此乃命运泥潭，大人愈是挣扎，愈是着恼，便会陷得愈深。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Katsutaka, I shall do everything just as you say. You are right. And so, there is something I wish to entrust to you. After I leave Sunpu, I want you to go and speak to my mother.”

units.source_en: “Katsutaka, I shall do everything just as you say.
units.source_zh: “胜隆，我会一一照你说的去做。

units.source_en: You are right.
units.source_zh: 你说得有理。

units.source_en: And so, there is something I wish to entrust to you.
units.source_zh: 因此，我想托你一事。

units.source_en: After I leave Sunpu, I want you to go and speak to my mother.”
units.source_zh: 待我离开骏府，麻烦你去告诉我母亲。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “胜隆，我会一一照你说的去做。你说得有理。因此，我想托你一事。待我离开骏府，麻烦你去告诉我母亲。”

paragraphs.source_en: “I understand. Whatever it may be, my lord, you need only command me.”

units.source_en: “I understand. Whatever it may be, my lord, you need only command me.”
units.source_zh: “在下明白，大人有事尽管吩咐。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “在下明白，大人有事尽管吩咐。”

paragraphs.source_en: “When you see my mother, tell her that O-Sen has suffered a terrible misfortune.”

units.source_en: “When you see my mother, tell her that O-Sen has suffered a terrible misfortune.”
units.source_zh: “你见到我母亲，告诉她，阿千不幸。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “你见到我母亲，告诉她，阿千不幸。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Lady Senhime?”

units.source_en: “Lady Senhime?”
units.source_zh: “千姬小姐？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “千姬小姐？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes. She lost not only her husband and her castle, but also the child in her womb. But happiness will return to her one day—Tadateru believes that without doubt. Tell Mother not to grieve.”

units.source_en: “Yes.
She lost not only her husband and her castle, but also the child in her womb.
units.source_zh: 她不仅失去了夫君和城池，肚里的孩子也掉了。

units.source_en: But happiness will return to her one day—Tadateru believes that without doubt. Tell Mother not to grieve.”
units.source_zh: 可是，幸福还会再次到她身边，忠辉深信不疑，请母亲莫要难过。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是。她不仅失去了夫君和城池，肚里的孩子也掉了。可是，幸福还会再次到她身边，忠辉深信不疑，请母亲莫要难过。”

paragraphs.source_en: Katsutaka turned his face away and sobbed softly. Tadateru was using Senhime’s plight to speak of his own unhappiness; realizing this, Katsutaka too felt his heart break.

units.source_en: Katsutaka turned his face away and sobbed softly.
units.source_zh: 胜隆扭开头，低声呜咽。

units.source_en: Tadateru was using Senhime’s plight to speak of his own unhappiness; realizing this, Katsutaka too felt his heart break.
units.source_zh: 忠辉乃是借千姬之事诉说自己的不幸，想到此，他亦感肝肠寸断。

paragraphs.source_zh: 胜隆扭开头，低声呜咽。忠辉乃是借千姬之事诉说自己的不幸，想到此，他亦感肝肠寸断。

paragraphs.source_en: “Katsutaka, if anything should happen to me, I entrust my children to you.”

units.source_en: “Katsutaka, if anything should happen to me, I entrust my children to you.”
units.source_zh: “胜隆，我若有万一，孩子就托付于你了。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “胜隆，我若有万一，孩子就托付于你了。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Of course. My father, too, will not forget your descendants.”

units.source_en: “Of course.
units.source_zh: “这是自然。

units.source_en: My father, too, will not forget your descendants.”
units.source_zh: 家父也不会忘了大人之后。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “这是自然。家父也不会忘了大人之后。”

units.source_en: “You have my deepest thanks!”

paragraphs.source_zh: “多谢大人！”

paragraphs.source_en: “We shall meet again. You must take good care of yourself.”

units.source_en: “We shall meet again. You must take good care of yourself.”
